descriptionChirho: To physically break, crush, or pulverize something into small pieces by beating or grinding (Qal/Piel active sense).
To hammer or beat metal into a new form, as in forging swords into plowshares or vice versa (Piel/Qal sense of reshaping by beating).
To crush or strike an enemy in battle, causing military defeat (Hifil causative sense).
To be broken, shattered, or crushed, whether as a passive state or ongoing condition (Hofal passive and Qal passive participle).
